description: Get one article's verbatim Arabic text as in force today (and French, when the Centre published it and no amendment has replaced it), its in-force status, amendment history, and the canonical and source URLs. When an amendment replaced the wording, text_ar is the new wording and centre_text_ar the earlier one the Centre's site still shows. The text is copied exactly from the database; nothing here is AI-written. Laws with ids from 2000000000 are ones the Lebanese University has not published yet, read by machine from scans of the Official Gazette's pages (unofficial copies, page images on the law's page); where the two readings differ the text shows both as ⟦reading one | reading two⟧: quote neither as certain. Not legal advice.

number.description: the article's printed number, e.g. "212" or "12 مكرر"

name: get_article
